title: ICAN Management System
description: A comprehensive web application designed for ICAN (Institute of Chartered Accountants of Nigeria) operations. Streamlines student registrations, exam records, administrative workflows, and certification verification in real time.
outcome: Impact: Automated ICAN records & reduced administrative processing overhead

case_study.problem: Manual student registration and paper records caused delays in processing certification verifications and exam rosters.
case_study.key_decisions: Chose Django REST framework for robust ORM security, role-based permission access control, and PostgreSQL relational data integrity.
case_study.result: Automated student record tracking and reduced administrative verification processing time.
case_study.hindsight: If rebuilding today, I would implement automated Redis caching for frequent student verification lookups.

title: SIWES Logbook Management System
description: A digital platform replacing manual paper logbooks for student industrial work experience. Built for university administrators, supervisors, and students to record daily activities and sign off documentation in real time.
outcome: Impact: Used by 200+ students · Reduced processing & sign-off time by ~75%

case_study.problem: University students used physical paper logbooks that were frequently lost, damaged, or delayed in manual sign-offs by supervisors.
case_study.key_decisions: Architected a dual-portal Django application with instant digital signature approvals and PDF logbook exports for academic records.
case_study.result: Adopted by 200+ active students, cutting sign-off turnaround time by ~75% and eliminating physical paperwork loss.
case_study.hindsight: I would add offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) sync so students in low-connectivity areas can log entries offline.

title: Inventory Store Manager
description: Real-time stock tracking and warehouse management app. Built to help small-to-mid businesses eliminate stock loss, automate re-order alerts, and track sales receipts.
outcome: Impact: Deployed for 2 Lagos retailers · 300+ products tracked

case_study.problem: Retail store owners experienced stock discrepancies and missed re-stocking deadlines due to pen-and-paper inventory management.
case_study.key_decisions: Built a fast React dashboard with WebSocket real-time low-stock alerts and automated sales receipt generation.
case_study.result: Deployed live for 2 Lagos retail outlets, tracking 300+ product SKUs with zero unrecorded inventory leakage.
case_study.hindsight: I would migrate to PostgreSQL for stricter transactional consistency across multi-store inventory transfers.

title: Fashion Brand E-commerce
description: A sleek storefront for a high-end fashion brand featuring interactive product filtering, instant cart management, and secure checkout integration.
outcome: Impact: Live store · Seamless multi-currency payment checkout

case_study.problem: Fashion brand needed a fast, high-converting digital storefront capable of handling surge traffic during drop releases.
case_study.key_decisions: Implemented Redux Toolkit state management for instant cart updates and optimized image lazy-loading.
case_study.result: Delivered a high-speed shopping experience with secure payment processing.
case_study.hindsight: I would leverage Next.js App Router Server Components for instant Server-Side Rendered (SSR) product pages.
